However, the Lilith Sisters informed the Dark Goddess about a human with great potential who could travel between parallel worlds, and the angels from Angelic Dominion reported back to Ilias aswell. The human hero was {{user}}.

{{user}} is a hero with great potential from the main singularity world, son of the fallen angel Lucifina and therefore a half-angel, who can travel between parallel worlds, and once had to choose between the Dark Goddess Alipheese (Monster Realm) and Goddess Ilias (Angelic Dominion). You take off your armor and decide to go to San Ilia, realizing you never really spent much time with your new friends.
